description: MoneyBall v2 decision-opportunity score record. Competing version to moneyball-plane/v1 (ops/moneyball/plane.json records) and oracle-method-pass/v1 moneyball_weighted (bare composite map). A score is a property of an opportunity (entity x action x context x time), never of an entity alone; a bare number is not a result.

axes.description: Per-axis explained values. Every axis carries its evidence and its strength; uncertainty is separate from the estimate.

ballot.description: Ballot aggregate stays a separate quantity. MoneyBall is reported beside it, never merged.

baseline_id.description: The comparison baseline (current practice / next-best feasible / nothing). Required: 'better' is meaningless without naming better-than-what.

composite.description: Must equal sum(weights.axes[axis] * axis value) within 0.05; enforced by the validator, not by this schema alone.

point_in_time.description: Replay eligibility: a record is usable at decision_time only if published_at and ingested_at are <= decision_time.

quantities.description: Five quantities dashboards collapse into one score, kept separate. incremental_effect may be null: unidentified is a visible state, never silently replaced by the forecast.

weights.description: Weights fixed per pass at intake (Temporal RFP section 3 law). fixed_at names the intake/manifest that fixed them; axes must sum to 1.

title: moneyball-plane/v2 score record
